span.p: main -- SpringApplication.run on KhiBackendApplication

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
spring-dotenv EnvironmentPostProcessor
merges a .env file into the Environment

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Does every placeholder in application.yaml resolve?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Startup aborts.
PGHOST, PGPORT, PGDATABASE, PGUSER, PGPASSWORD,
JWT_SECRET, JWT_EXPIRATION_MS and every JWT_COOKIE_*
are declared with NO default value.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HikariCP opens the PostgreSQL pool
jdbc:postgresql://PGHOST:PGPORT/PGDATABASE

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Database reachable and credentials accepted?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hibernate builds the EntityManagerFactory
and scans every @Entity under ak.dev.khi_backend

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hibernate ALTERs the LIVE schema to match the entities:
creates missing tables, adds missing columns,
creates element-collection side tables.
It never drops and never renames.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EVERY TABLE IS DROPPED AND RECREATED.
All production data is lost, with no prompt
and no backup. Never set this value here.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Schema is checked, or ignored, but not changed

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No Flyway. No Liquibase. No migration file, no review step:
merging an entity change IS the migration.
A renamed field leaves the old column behind, still holding the data.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Remaining singletons are created

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
@EnableJpaAuditing wires AuditorAwareImpl
-- created_by falls back to the string SYSTEM when anonymous

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S3Client built for us-east-1.
DefaultCredentialsProvider.create does NOT resolve credentials here.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SecurityFilterChain assembled at order -100.
TraceIdFilter and JWTAuthenticationFilter auto-register
as plain servlet filters at LOWEST_PRECEDENCE.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MessageSource loads classpath:i18n/messages
springdoc scans ak.dev.khi_backend for /api/** paths
